DGtal: Mesh Voxelization
Author (s) of this documentation: David Coeurjolly, Monir Hadji See also DGtalTools MeshVoxelizer Introduction This documentation describes a voxelization approach of a triangulated structure. The proposed approach follows the method described by Laine [78].
